name: Discord Docker Updater (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Discord bot that receives Diun Docker image-update webhooks, posts interactive Discord alerts, and lets an authorized operator approve Docker Compose updates; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker host, Docker Compose, Diun, a Discord bot token and Discord server; infrastructure is not included. Bot can control Docker through the Docker socket and execute container updates, creating privileged host security and availability risks. Protect webhook endpoints, credentials and agent access; inspect changes and back up before approving updates. Discord platform policies apply; not a hosted notification allowance.
